title: Release v2.24-multisolver-0.2: equivalence with official CalculiX 2.24

code.note: compared against tag ccx-2.24-upstream (57a4e71) built with upstream's own CMake

summary: SPOOLES: all 642 decks of the official test suite give byte-identical .dat and .frd results to plain 2.24 on 1 thread, and 635 on 4 threads (7 CFD decks within tolerance, as in upstream). MUMPS 629/642 and PARDISO 627/642 identical or within tolerance; the rest are explained.
notes: Also covers 4 threads with and without multithreaded SPOOLES, and a macOS smoke test against Dhondt's .dat.ref files.

Multithreaded SPOOLES (USE_MT, on by default) gives results that differ from run to run and from single-threaded SPOOLES with several threads; documented with a warning. Single-threaded SPOOLES (CCX_NPROC_EQUATION_SOLVER=1 or CCX_SPOOLES_MT=OFF) reproduces 2.24.
